text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Author(x, y) ::: y is the author of x.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Create(x, y) ::: x created y.
FamilyHistory ::: the book Family History.
FamilySecrets ::: the podcast Family Secrets.
DaniShapiro ::: Dani Shapiro.
City(y) ::: y is a city.
AmericanCity(y) ::: y is an American city.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
WrittenIn(x, y) ::: x was written in year y.
Publication(x) ::: x is a publication.
Premises:
¬Podcast(FamilySecrets) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornIn(x, y) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, then the person is American.
∀x ∀y (Novel(x) ∧ WrittenBy(x, y) → ∀z (Author(y, z) → Novel(z))) ::: If a book is novel and written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
Author(DaniShapiro, DaniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an author of herself.
Book(FamilyHistory) ::: Family History is a book.
WrittenBy(FamilyHistory, DaniShapiro) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
WrittenIn(FamilyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History was written in 2003.
Create(DaniShapiro, FamilySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created Family Secrets.
City(Boston) ::: Boston is a city.
AmericanCity(Boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
Novel(FamilySecrets) ::: Family Secrets is a novel.
